memberdef.name: bulkLoad

briefdescription.para: Bulk-load a collection of (primary_key, sidecar) pairs into the spatial index for a given table.

detaileddescription.para: Uses STR (Sort-Tile-Recursive) packing via GeoRTree::bulkLoad(), which is 3–5× faster than incremental insertion for read-heavy workloads. Replaces any previously cached in-memory R-tree for the table.
Memory usage is reported as a structured log entry with field geo_index_bytes_allocated after the bulk load completes.

parameterdescription.para: Name of the table whose spatial index should be populated.
Vector of {primary_key, GeoSidecar} pairs to index.

simplesect.para: Status::OK() on success or Status::Error() if the table has no spatial index registered.
